instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to learn in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: What do you learn in your English lessons?
atoms.b: What do you ((learn)) in your English lessons?

atoms.b: Yesterday, I ((learnt)) a lot about life in the city.

atoms.sound: I haven't ((learnt)) anything this interesting in a long time.

atoms.sound: Why do you never hear the phone ring?.
atoms.b: Why do you never hear the phone ((ring))?

atoms.sound: The phone has already rung five times today.

atoms.sound: I haven't shown my new room to anyone but you.
atoms.b: I haven't ((shown)) my new room to anyone but you.
